requirements.text: The EIRENE system must support GSM teleservices including Telephony, Emergency calls, Short Message Service (MT/PP, MO/PP, Cell Broadcast), Voice Group Call Service (VGCS), and Voice Broadcast Service (VBS).
The EIRENE system must support GSM bearer services including asynchronous and synchronous data services, and GPRS.
The EIRENE system must support GSM supplementary services including CLIP, CoLP, Call Forwarding, Call Waiting, Call Hold, Multi-Party, CUG, eMLPP, USSD, and UUS1.
The EIRENE system must support railway-specific services including functional addressing, location-dependent addressing, shunting mode, multiple driver communications, and railway emergency calls.
The network must provide a coverage probability of 95% at a field strength of 38.5 dBµV/m for voice/data, and 41.5 dBµV/m for ETCS levels 2/3 at speeds up to 220 km/h.
The network must achieve a handover success rate of at least 99.5% under design load conditions.
The network must ensure call setup times are within the limits defined in the EIRENE FRS with authentication and ciphering enabled.
The network must support authentication and encryption as defined in the GSM standard.
Cab radios must support the initiation of Railway emergency calls, calls to controllers, and calls to other drivers in the area using eMLPP priority levels.
Cab radios must support the registration and deregistration of train numbers and stock numbers using USSD messages.
Cab radios must be capable of operating in the R-GSM frequency band (876-915 MHz / 921-960 MHz).
Cab radios must provide a service availability indication and an MMI for volume adjustment and call management.
All EIRENE mobile equipment must comply with environmental, EMC, and physical specifications defined in the GSM standard and relevant railway standards (e.g., prEN 50155, ENV 50121).
The system must support the use of SIM cards compliant with the MORANE FFFIS for GSM-R SIM Cards.
The network must terminate ongoing VGCS/VBS calls upon receiving the '***' DTMF sequence from an entitled controller.
